test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the saving and expenditure of 5 companies C, D, E, F and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/637d1953d8f73d69d807329f99c69ba924f19b55357a39f44d9d73bba050ba15.png] 

Income = Saving + Expenditure

What is the ratio of total expenditure to the total incomes of all the companies?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Income = Saving + Expenditure

Total income = 600 + 400 + 1100 + 700 + 900 + 600 + 600 + 500 + 1300 + 700 = 7400

Total expenditure = 400 + 700 + 600 + 500 + 1300 = 3500

The ratio of total expenditure to the total incomes of all the companies

3500 : 7400

35 : 74 

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
